description: Filters the tracked companies on revenue growth, margins, price/sales, market cap, trend or segment, and sorts the result by one of these measures. Use it when the user asks which companies meet numeric criteria, for example revenue growth above 40% with a gross margin above 60%. A company whose filtered figure does not exist (not filed, or a ratio between two currencies) is listed separately in `notComparable` with the reason; it is not below the threshold.

minGrossMargin.description: Minimum gross margin of the latest quarter, as a fraction.

minOperatingMargin.description: Minimum operating margin of the latest quarter, as a fraction.

minRevenueGrowth.description: Minimum revenue growth of the latest quarter against the same quarter a year earlier (a fiscal year for `basis` 'fiscal year'), as a fraction (0.4 = 40%).

minRevenueGrowthTtm.description: Minimum revenue growth over the trailing twelve months (the last four quarters against the four before; a fiscal year for `basis` 'fiscal year'), as a fraction.

segment.description: Restrict to one or more segments, comma-separated, e.g. 'compute,memory,equipment' — any of: compute, interconnect, optics, memory, systems, power, neocloud, equipment, software, platform, other.

trend.description: Only companies in this trend: 'up' (price above its 50-day and 200-day averages, the 50-day above the 200-day), 'down' (the reverse), 'neutral' (neither; 'flat' is accepted for it).

name: screen_companies
title: Screen companies by criteria
